the effects of ether-linked lipids on cell membranes and the mechanisms by which they may influence cell function.
the effects of alkylglycero lipids on cell membrane structure and function.

alkylglycerophosphocholine and alkylacylglycero-phosphocholine, two major components of the alkyldi- acylglycerol supplement, are incorporated into the major phospholipid fractions of liver, lung, and kidney tissue of rats.

alkylglycerophosphocholines, which are present in human tissues, can be readily synthesized from alkylglyceroids.
